scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && vp build && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:ths: vp run build:ths && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.deploy:self-hosted: vp run build:self-hosted && wrangler deploy --config dist/server/wrangler.json
scripts.db:migrate:ths: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.ths.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:self-hosted: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.self-hosted.jsonc
scripts.self-host:check: node scripts/check-self-host-config.mjs && TSEWA_WRANGLER_CONFIG=wrangler.self-hosted.jsonc vp build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config dist/server/wrangler.json

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generate a unique secret of at least 32 random bytes for authentication.

DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_NAME.description: The school or care organization shown on the sign-in screen.

DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_SLUG.description: A stable lowercase identifier such as `example-school`.

DEFAULT_ORGANIZATION_TITLE.description: The short installation title shown above the organization name.

DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.description: The organization's IANA timezone, such as `Asia/Kolkata`.

TRANSACTIONAL_FROM_EMAIL.description: The sender to use after its domain and EMAIL binding are configured.
